3. Manila Dossier Deep-Dive: Expandable architectural tabs with real-time telemetry streams.
4. Developer License Badge: Hologram shimmer, security microprint borders, and QR verification.
5. Flight Log Journey: Desktop fanning timeline + Mobile horizontal touch-swipe carousel.
6. Postal Mail Form: Interactive desk stationery with wax seal transmit interaction.
